newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Austrian Airlines, East Line open booking office.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Airlines, East Line open booking office.

text.p: Austrian Airlines and Russian East Line travel agency opened a joint booking office on Wednesday to sell air tickets and tourist packages on Wednesday.

Vladimir Vorozhemsky, Austrian Airlines sales manager for Russia, told a news conference his company had decided to set up a joint office with East Line because of growing tourist and business traffic between Russia and Austria.
"The office will offer tickets in a package with a small discount compared to usual air tickets," he said.
East Line is a leading travel agent in Russia. It has branches in Moscow and nine other Russian cities.
Vorozhemsky also said Austrian Airlines was planning to start regular flights between Vienna and Krasnodar in southern Russia in October.
"We are planning to make flights twice a week by 80-seat Fokker-70 aircraft," he said.
Currently, the airline makes flights from Vienna to eight destinations in the former Soviet Union.
